class.name: PlayFabMatchmakingMember
class.brief_description: One local member in a matchmaking ticket.
class.description: Wraps one local signed-in [PlayFabUser] and optional JSON-serializable attributes used by [method PlayFabMultiplayer.create_match_ticket_async] or [method PlayFabMultiplayer.join_match_ticket_async]. This class never represents a remote premade member; use [member PlayFabMatchmakingTicketConfig.members_to_match_with] for remote entity keys.

members.member: Local signed-in PlayFab user whose entity handle is added to the ticket.
Per-member matchmaking attributes serialized to JSON.
